_comment: The single source of truth for what Objeck needs from the operating system.
tools/cicd/check_docs_deps.py enforces it in both directions:
--artifacts: the libraries a built deploy tree actually links must match 'sonames'/'external'
--portable:  a Linux RELEASE tree must meet linux.release (docs/design/PORTABLE_LINUX.md)
--docs:      every package a doc tells users to install must be listed here
Linux has two builds. linux.sonames is a build from source against Ubuntu 24.04's own
libraries, which is what CI and a developer make. linux.release is the published tarball
and .deb, built in an AlmaLinux 8 container with mbedTLS and OpenCV linked in.
Change this file in the same PR as any change to what the binaries link, and the
docs gate names every page that still says otherwise.
The x64 and arm64 soname lists are currently IDENTICAL, which is a consequence
and not a coincidence: since #1048 vendored an aarch64 ONNX Runtime, both Linux
legs build the same eight native libraries. They stay separate lists because an
arch can legitimately need something the other does not -- so if they diverge
again, that divergence means something.
The published Linux tarball and .deb. bin/* may link toolchain_sonames and core_sonames
and nothing else; so may each of self_contained_natives, plus files in the tree.
core_sonames is zlib alone: every dpkg, rpm and pacman system has libz.so.1, because its
package manager links it, and a static zlib made obc 20% slower. 'sonames' is everything the
remaining native libraries (odbc, lame, sdl, opencv) take from the system: each is optional,
and a program that loads one without them stops with the loader's message, exit 1.
max_symbol_versions is the newest symbol version any file may ask of glibc, libstdc++ and
libgcc: AlmaLinux 8's. obd looks for readline_dlopen at run time and works without it.
tested_images is what tools/packaging/test_portable_linux.sh runs the tarball on;
its --natives mode leaves out natives_untested, where the optional bindings are not
promised: AlmaLinux 8's own repositories have no SDL2_image, SDL2_mixer or SDL2_ttf,
and its SDL2 2.0.10 is older than libobjk_sdl needs. x64_only_images have no arm64
image to run: Arch Linux is an x86-64 distribution (Arch Linux ARM is a separate project).

macos._comment: Links a macOS package may make outside itself and /usr/lib, /System. None: since v2026.9.3 every third-party library ships inside the package (tools/deps/build_macos_deps.sh).

retired.nghttp2: obr links HTTP/2 statically since v2026.9.3 (tools/deps/build_quic_deps.sh)
retired.ngtcp2: obr links QUIC statically since v2026.9.3 (tools/deps/build_quic_deps.sh)
retired.nghttp3: obr links HTTP/3 statically since v2026.9.3 (tools/deps/build_quic_deps.sh)
retired.gnutls: obr's HTTP/3 uses statically linked AWS-LC since v2026.9.3, not GnuTLS
